decisions.question: What constitutes a compaction input and its provenance?
decisions.answer: Recognize physical containers, then separately classify representation and producer. Include Pi custom and compaction variants and Claude summary/boundary; permit explicitly configured Claude diagnostic roots. Preserve lifecycle and coverage separately; fromHook or a heading alone does not prove Shadow provenance.
decisions.rationale: Observed 29 custom checkpoints, 23 Shadow compaction occurrences, 9 native-format hook compactions and 5 Claude summary/boundary pairs. Five Shadow compactions lack a structured twin.

alternatives.rejected_because: Drops five observed compaction-only Shadow inputs and native task state

alternatives.rejected_because: All nine standard-format Pi records are fromHook=true; quoted headings are not containers

decisions.tradeoff: More container variants, but no speculative authentication or broad diagnostic crawling

decisions.question: What minimal relational representation preserves useful information?
decisions.answer: Propose three transient tables: summaries (physical occurrences, separate acceptance/verifier/installation statuses, and scope), summary_items (exact section/item/subfield/block claims), summary_refs (snapshot-namespaced citations and resolution). One decoder owns parsing; retain compatible events/checkpoints. Exact session/producer identity plus compatible coverage/content groups proven twins without deleting occurrences; D6 defines non-twins.
decisions.rationale: Real checkpoints carry typed uncertainty, rationale and citations that current claim strings flatten; separate grains prevent citation fanout and duplicate observations.

alternatives.option: Single global latest-state or persistent memory table
alternatives.rejected_because: Loses provenance/coverage and conflicts with invocation-local evidence-first design

alternatives.option: One row per entire summary JSON
alternatives.rejected_because: Already largely available; does not expose section/status/ref retrieval

decisions.tradeoff: Three explicit grains instead of one broad row; no semantic atomization of arbitrary native prose

decisions.question: How should deterministic parsing and evidence resolution work?
decisions.answer: Decode known structured versions first; parse rendering only within recognized containers, with fence-aware section/block handling. Preserve native split-turn scope, wrappers, unknown sections and partial states. Resolve Pi labels against the exact prepared branch and Claude labels against its diagnostic snapshot; E0000 is prior summary. Never infer missing references.
decisions.rationale: Observed Pi renderer drops citations; Claude preserves them. Real Pi standard sample has different history and split-turn requests. Pi branch-position citations were resolved to original failure/fix tool records.

alternatives.option: Generic heading regex or LLM normalization
alternatives.rejected_because: Would blur nested/split scope and cannot restore missing producer evidence maps

decisions.tradeoff: Unknown native variants stay opaque/partial instead of guessed semantics

E0230/E0234 map to original failed/passing tool records
Rendering strips evidenceRefs
Rendering includes coverage and citation suffixes

decisions.revisit: Corpus variants defeat conservative section/snapshot recognition

decisions.question: When should Remember select Shadow, native, or both?
decisions.answer: Select per query/branch/coverage and proven representation group. Prefer JSON only for consistent, proven twins; use native alone when available alone. Preserve non-twins for complementary or incomparable scopes, possible alternatives, and older rationale/uncertainty; no semantic equivalence or contradiction classifier is implied (D6). Canonical-install evidence controls current-summary preference (D7). Inspect uncovered/retained tail for current-state requests. Raw outcomes and original human authority are never replaceable by summary claims.
decisions.rationale: Shadow brand does not establish accuracy. A later summary may be current while older structured rationale remains useful; absence in a summary does not resolve an obligation. Revised after independent challenge to specify equivalence and lifecycle in D6/D7.

alternatives.option: Always prefer Shadow
alternatives.rejected_because: Coverage/freshness can differ; rendered-only Shadow can be poorer than native

alternatives.option: Always concatenate both
alternatives.rejected_because: Duplicates twins, mixes scope and floods leads

alternatives.option: Numerical trust scores and automatic semantic merge
alternatives.rejected_because: No measured evidence for calibrated accuracy or safe conflict resolution

decisions.tradeoff: Explainable reason codes and occasional dual-source output instead of automatic truth selection

decisions.question: What mechanical rules make non-twin selection deterministic without fuzzy semantic equivalence or conflict resolution?
decisions.answer: Dedup delivery only for proven same-session/producer-ID twins with compatible known coverage and consistent recognized text/status. Same-ID content mismatch retains both with representation_mismatch. Non-twins remain distinct, including identical text; differing text/status yields comparison=unresolved, not a proven contradiction. For current continuation, prefer latest comparable on-branch evidence endpoint among canonically installed sources; equal/incomparable/unknown endpoints preserve alternatives. Stable source-ref/item order resolves delivery ties; clipping reports counts/continuations, not supersession.
decisions.rationale: Conservative proposal removes an unvalidated semantic equivalence dependency and preserves snapshot provenance. Simplicity choice, not measured retrieval superiority.

alternatives.option: Suppress semantically similar non-twins or classify contradictions
alternatives.rejected_because: Requires unvalidated semantic identity/conflict decisions outside this investigation

alternatives.option: Wall-clock latest wins for incomparable coverage
alternatives.rejected_because: Publication can lag preparation and branches/retained tails differ

decisions.tradeoff: More alternate leads and less dedup in return for deterministic inspectable provenance

Conservative policy proposal; no quality calibration claimed

decisions.question: How does lifecycle affect retrieval eligibility and current-summary preference?
decisions.answer: Canonical host compaction or matching authoritative confirmation permits on-branch current-summary preference, not claim truth. Accepted/prepared/custom-only/attempted-but-unconfirmed summaries remain contextual/historical and cannot displace a confirmed current summary; if alone, report unconfirmed preparation rather than installed current state. Recognized Pi custom publication with acceptance unknown may remain contextual with unknown lifecycle. Unaccepted/rejected/arbitrary worker drafts are diagnostic-only, excluded from ordinary task/current-state leads. Preserve acceptance, verifier and installation evidence independently.
decisions.rationale: Preparation/publication and canonical installation are distinct source events. Conservative eligibility avoids silently promoting prepared results to canonical state; proposed policy, not evaluated superiority.

alternatives.option: Any accepted/latest prepared checkpoint replaces installed summary
alternatives.rejected_because: Acceptance does not establish canonical installation or current state

alternatives.option: Discard every uninstalled/unknown custom source
alternatives.rejected_because: Loses useful attributed rationale/uncertainty and existing custom-only Remember leads

decisions.tradeoff: Additional labeled contextual leads while canonical-install evidence controls resume preference

Conservative proposed eligibility; no inferred task success
